originalDsl:
@diagram architecture
layout [direction: DOWN]
User service as "User"
ResetForm service as "Password Reset Request"
AuthService service as "Auth Service"
TokenStore database as "Reset Token Store"
EmailService service as "Email Service"
NewPasswordForm service as "New Password Form"

edge_1 = User -> ResetForm as "submits email address"
edge_2 = ResetForm -> AuthService as "request reset token"
edge_3 = AuthService -> TokenStore as "store token"
edge_4 = AuthService -> EmailService as "send reset email"
edge_5 = EmailService -> User as "deliver reset link"
edge_6 = User -> NewPasswordForm as "submits new password"

injectedDefects.description: replaced closing quote on label "Password Reset Request" with Unicode look-alike U+201D
